description: This file defines the IZigWave interface for ZigBee or ZigWave device control within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for managing device acceptance modes, retrieving device metadata, listing devices, and creating or removing bindings between devices.

classes.name: IZigWave
classes.description: An interface for ZigWave device management, including accepting new devices, retrieving device info, listing devices, and binding/unbinding devices.

methods.name: Permutable
methods.description: Sets or queries whether a device at a specific address is accepting new devices.

methods.name: Device
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a device given its ID.

methods.name: Devices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all available device IDs.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Creates a binding between a source and destination device.

methods.name: Unbind
methods.description: Removes the binding between a source and destination device.

ctags.name: IZigWave
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IZigWave : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
